name: gitstack
description: Bundle git authoring, git/gh-first GitHub operations, maintainer and portfolio triage, and publish workflows, with shared ghflow helpers for focused CI inspection, higher-level review, star-list, portfolio-scan, and publish flows.

interface.shortDescription: Bundle git commit, git/gh-first GitHub workflows, maintainer and portfolio triage, and narrow shared helpers in one plugin.
interface.longDescription: GitStack keeps normal work centered on `git` and `gh`, with `git-commit`, `github`, specialist GitHub skills, and Yeet using shared `ghflow` helpers only where focused failing-PR CI inspection, review-thread routing, authenticated-user stars or star lists, read-only portfolio scans, or current-branch publish helpers justify extra tooling. Focused current-repo issue/PR queue triage routes to the bundled `github-triage` skill, while broad or multi-repo queue triage routes to `github-portfolio-triage`; both stay report-only until the user asks for follow-up action.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repo's open issues and PRs.
Scan this portfolio's GitHub queues across multiple repositories.
Turn these local changes into a draft PR.
Create a clean commit and open or reuse the PR.
